description: CTO DURABLE STATE / BACKUP / VERIFIED RESTORE: a reproducible, integrity-verified export + verify + isolated-restore for ODG's gitignored OPERATIONAL STATE (incident ledger + autonomy outcomes + local mission contracts), REUSING the proven client-store-backup verify/restore engine (no duplicated backup/restore logic, no new primitive). Read-only on source; fail-closed on tamper/truncation/invalid-manifest/version-mismatch/dangerous-path; refuses the source/prod dirs + a non-empty target (unless --force). Secrets never embedded (scan + exclude). Full content archive stays OUT of git (gitignored backup dir); git keeps the tool, tests, doc, and a NON-SENSITIVE manifest summary. Off-VPS copy = BLOCKED (no independent destination configured) — honestly reported, never faked.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MISSION PRIORITAIRE — DURABLE STATE, COMPLETE BACKUP & VERIFIED RESTORE (Gate A diagnostic validated by ODG; Gate B reversible internal changes).

work_item_contract.objective: odg-state-backup (both ports): export(scope)→content-embedded manifest {version,createdAtMs,base,files:[{path,sha256,bytes,content}],manifestHash} (manifestHash algorithm identical to client-store-backup so its verify accepts it) + a non-sensitive summary; verify (reuse engine); restore to an explicit isolated target (reuse engine, refuse source/prod + non-empty unless --force). Read-only source; secret-scan guard refuses embedding credential patterns.
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: Gate A: ODG operational state (incident ledger 65K + autonomy outcomes + 260 gitignored mission contracts) is LOCAL runtime state, NOT reproduced on a fresh clone; the existing odg-backup is scoped to the client store, NOT this state. REUSE client-store-backup verify/restore (generic, tested 18+12) for a new operational scope.
work_item_contract.scope: New thin CLI runtime/bin/odg-state-backup (both ports) reusing client-store-backup.{verify,restore}; a scope-manifest builder (same manifest shape + manifestHash algorithm) + secret-scan + summary. Doc. Tests. INCLUDE: runtime/generated/autonomy/*.json + runtime/missions/*.json. EXCLUDE (justified): reconstructible runtime/generated per-run artifacts + dist + logs + scans; the client store (separate sensitive backup); node_modules/.git (versioned/reconstructible); secrets/.env/keys (policy). NO source mutation.
invariants: READ-ONLY on source (backup never mutates the ledger/contracts).
Reuse client-store-backup.verify/restore (no duplicated integrity logic; no new primitive).

FAIL-CLOSED: tamper/truncation/invalid-manifest/version-mismatch/integrity-mismatch ⇒ refuse; restore refuses source/prod dirs + non-empty target unless --force; dangerous (absolute/..) paths rejected.
Secrets NEVER embedded: a credential-pattern match ⇒ refuse export (fail-closed).
Full content archive NOT committed to git (gitignored backup dir); git keeps tool/tests/doc + non-sensitive summary only.
Off-VPS copy claimed ONLY if actually verified (none configured ⇒ BLOCKED).
Preserve the 5 stashes, worktree, boussole, research; delete/overwrite nothing existing.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible export (same scope + fixed nowMs ⇒ identical manifestHash); engine verify accepts the manifest; tamper/truncation ⇒ verify INTEGRITY_MISMATCH/INVALID_MANIFEST; restore to a temp sandbox reconstructs byte-identical files; restored==source compare; restore refuses source/prod target + non-empty (no --force) + dangerous paths + version mismatch; secret-scan refuses a seeded secret; NO source mutation (ledger/contracts unchanged before==after); dual-port parity; non-regression of odg-backup/client-store-backup suites; tsc 0. LIVE: real operational-state export + verify + restore-to-sandbox + compare PASS; summary written; full archive to a gitignored dir (not committed).
stop_conditions: A secret would be embedded; source would be mutated; a target would be the real source/prod store; an off-VPS destination is required but unavailable (⇒ BLOCKED, documented).
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f runtime/bin/odg-state-backup.ts runtime/bin/odg-state-backup.js runtime/bin/odg-state-backup.test.ts docs/operational-backup.md runtime/missions/OPERATIONAL_STATE_BACKUP.json; npm run build:runtime.

objectives.goal: Reproducible, integrity-verified, fail-closed export+verify+isolated-restore of ODG operational state reusing the proven engine; secrets never embedded; archive out of git; off-VPS honestly BLOCKED; both ports; proven live + tested.
done_when: All acceptance_criteria met; committed in write-set; live export/verify/restore/compare proven.

definition_of_done: An integrity-verified, reproducible, fail-closed operational-state backup/verify/restore tool (both ports) reusing client-store-backup; secrets excluded; full archive gitignored; a non-sensitive summary + doc committed; isolated restore proven byte-identical; off-VPS copy honestly BLOCKED; source/worktree/5 stashes preserved; committed (no force).
